name: PREPARE_TO_STOP_SIGNALS_LANTERNS_BLACK_LONG
legend: PREPARE TO STOP (traffic signals, two flashing lanterns)
notes: TfNSW design plan (Roads & Maritime 2019 style, upright A3 sheet). 2500 x 1200 (the sheet's only size), R150, Cl.400 white border 24 with a 12 black edge outside it (12 / 24). Warning sign 'See W3-3(B)': the 750 AS 1743 diamond (bounding square 1060.66 at 100 / 70: 100/1060/131 across, 70/1060/70 down) as polygons (yellow edge 10, black border 30, R50 as the AS 1743 W3-3 drawing) with the w3-3_signals symbol at the AS 1743 box (320.33 / 225.33, 420 x 672). PREPARE TO STOP panel 1109 x 600 at 1291 / 100 (1291/100/909/100/100 across, 100/600 down; white border 24, R75, red ground), PREPARE / TO STOP 160 D white tops 200 / 440 (100/160/80/160/100), 909 and 275 / 93 / 500. Lantern housing 770 x 244 at 1460 / 810 (1460/42/200/43/200/43/200/42/270 across; 110 / 244 / 146 down): two 200 mm amber lanterns drawn as yellow discs R100 at 1602 / 932 and 2088 / 932; the centre lantern position is blanked out (dashed on the plan) and the housing outline is not drawn. 'Lanterns to flash alternately when amber/red is showing on traffic signals.'
